theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_cbm_st_slice_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (a b : ℝ) (h : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), a ≤ b → IntegrableOn h {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ j, a < z j ∧ z j < b} → IntegrableOn (fun y : Fin m → ℝ => ∫ t in a..b, h (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.insertNth i t y))) {y : Fin m → ℝ | ∀ j, a < y j ∧ y j < b} ∧ ∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ j, a < z j ∧ z j < b}, h x = ∫ y in {y : Fin m → ℝ | ∀ j, a < y j ∧ y j < b}, ∫ t in a..b, h (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.insertNth i t y))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
